title: Neon Paw Plasma Sphere
description: A glowing plasma globe with a bright pink paw print at its center emits vibrant neon rays in green, blue, yellow, and pink. Black and pink paw prints cascade from a glass tube extending from the sphere, falling onto a wooden surface like a waterfall, with a dark pine tree silhouette in the background.
prompt: A surreal glowing plasma ball sculpture sitting on a metallic base on a wooden table, featuring a bright pink paw print core with radiating neon green, blue, yellow and pink energy beams inside a glass sphere. A clear tube extends from the sphere with pink and black paw prints flowing out like a waterfall cascading down onto the surface. Dark background with floating paw prints and a tall black pine tree silhouette on the right. Moody cinematic lighting with vibrant neon reflections.
